questions.question: A student requires 221 days attendance to appear in an examination. A students has 208 days attendance and is declared ineligible by 5% attendance. What is the percentage of attendance required to appear in the examination?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Attendance required = 221 days

**Calculation:**

Number of days attended by student = 208

Let total attendance be n,

∴ ⇒ 208 + 5/100 × n = 221

⇒ n = 260

Total attendance days = 260

Attendance Required = 221/260 × 100 = 85

**∴ Attendance required to appear in examination is 85% **

questions.question: The average score of 40 students of section A is 92. Two students of the class having average score 95, moved to another section and 2 new students replaced them. Now the average score of section A is 90. What is the average score of the students who joined section A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average score of section A = 92

New average of section A = 90

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of observations/number of observations

**Calculation:**

Total score of section A = 92 × 40 = 3680

Total score of moved students = 95 × 2 = 190

Total score after two students left = 3680 - 190 = 3490

Total new score after two students joined = 90 × 40 = 3600

Total score of new 2 students = 3600 - 3490 = 110

**∴ **Average of two new students = 110/2 = 55

**Hence, Average score of new student is 55.**

questions.question: A metallic slab having dimensions 35 cm × 11 cm × 20 cm is melted and recasted in the shape of a wire of radius 0.7 mm. What is the length of the wire (in m)? (Use π = dfrac{22}{7})
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of metallic slab = 35 × 11 × 20

Radius of wire = 0.7mm

**Formula:**

Volume of cuboid = l × b × h

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Volume of metallic slab = 35 × 11 × 20 = 7700 cm³

Volume of cylindrical wire = 7700 cm3

Radius of wire = 0.7mm = 0.07cm

Volume of cylindrical wire = π × 0.07² × h

⇒ 7700 = 22/7 × 0.07 × 0.07 × h

⇒ h = 500000 cm

⇒ h = 5000 m

**∴ Length of wire is 5000 m.**

questions.question: Sarita took a loan of Rs. 18,600 partly at 5% and rest at 8% per annum simple interest. She paid a total of Rs.4,800 after 4 years as interest. What is the difference in the money borrowed at two different rates of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs.18600, Rate of interest = 5% and 8%

Time = 4 years, Simple interest = Rs.4800

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P = Principal, R = rate of interest, T = time

**Calculation:**

Let amount invested at rate of interest 5% be Rs.a and 8% be Rs.(18600 - a)

⇒ 4800 = a × 5 × 4/100 + (18600 - a) × 8 × 4/100

⇒ 4800 = 20a/100 + 595200/100 - 32a/100

⇒ 12a/100 = 1152

⇒ a = 9600

Sum borrowed at 5% = Rs.9600

Sum borrowed at 8% = 18600 - 9600 = Rs.9000

Difference = 9600 - 9000 = 600

**Hence, The difference in the money is Rs. 600**

questions.question: A shopkeeper earns a profit of 35% when he sells articles at a discount of 10%. What will be the profit percentage if he gives 20% discounts?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let MP = 100, Then SP = 100 - 10 = 90

⇒ CP × 135/100 = SP

⇒ CP = 90 × 100/135 = 66.67

If Discount = 20% i.e. 20% of 100 = 20

Then SP = 100 - 20 = 80

Profit = 80 - 66.67 = 13.33

Profit % = (13.33/66.67) × 100 = 20%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit % = 35% and Discount % = 10%

**Formula:**

Profit = SP - CP 

Where SP = selling price, CP = Cost price

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of an article be Rs.100

⇒ 35 = (SP - 100)/100 × 100

Selling price = Rs.135, then

⇒ 135 = marked price × (100 - 10)/100

⇒ Marked price = Rs.150

SP for 20% discount = 150 × (100 - 20)/100 = Rs.120

Profit% for 20% discount = (120 - 100)/100 × 100 = 20%

**Hence, the profit percentage for 20% discount is 20.**

questions.question: Six men can complete a work in 48 days. In how many days will 4 men and 8 women complete the same work, if one man does as muck work as 2 women?

1 man = 2 women

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

Where, M = number of men and D = days

**Calculation:**

Efficiency of women (W) = M/2

⇒ 6 × 48 = (4 + (8/2)) × D

⇒ D = (6 × 48)/8 = 36

**Hence, The work will be completed in 36 days.**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 33. If their LCM and HCF are 72 and 3, respectively, then what is the difference in the numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

LCM = 72

HCF = 3

Sum of numbers = 33

**Formula:**

LCM × HCF = product of numbers

**Calculation:**

Product of numbers = 72 × 3 = 216

Let two numbers be a and b.

⇒ ab = 216

⇒ a = 216/b

⇒ a + b = 33

⇒ 216/b + b = 33

⇒ b² - 33b + 216 = 0

Solving,

⇒ b² - 24b - 9b + 216 = 0

⇒ b(b - 24) - 9(b - 24) = 0

⇒ b = 24 or b = 9

⇒ a = 9 or a = 24

**∴ Required difference = 24 - 9 = 15**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

LCM = 72 and HCF = 3

Let, the numbers are 3a and 3b where a > b and a, b are prime to each other

Then, LCM of 3a and 3b = 3ab

3ab = 72 

⇒ ab = 24 ----(1)

Again, 3a + 3b = 33

⇒ a + b = 11 ----(2)

Squaring both sides of (2) and using (1) get,

(a + b)² = 11²

⇒ (a - b)² + 4ab = 121

⇒ (a - b)² = 121 - 4 × 24

⇒ (a - b) = 5 ----(3) [∵ a > b, (a - b) > 0]

From (2) and (3) get,

a = 8 and b = 3

Difference in the number = 3a - 3b = 3 × (8 - 3) = 15

**∴ The required difference in the number is 15.**

questions.question: A number when divided by 119 leaves remainder 19. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 17?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number is divided by 119 then leaves reminder 19.

**Concept Used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

**Calculation:**

Let the quotient be 1,

⇒ Dividend = 119 × 1 + 19

⇒ Dividend = 119 + 19

⇒ Dividend = 138

Now when 138 is divided by 17,

⇒ 138/17

⇒ 8(2)/({17)}

**∴ The remainder is 2**

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought two computer printers of different companies for Rs. 10,500. By selling one printer at a gain of 20% and the other printer at a loss of 10%, he finds that the selling price of each printer is the same. What is the net profit or loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price of two computers = Rs. 10,500

Profit in first Computer = 20%

Loss on second Computer = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Gain or Profit = (SP – CP),

Gain percent = (Gain/CP) × 100,

Loss = CP – SP,

Loss percent = (Loss/CP) × 100,

where, CP is cost price, and SP is selling price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of two computers be Rs. x and Rs. y respectively

According to the question,

⇒ x + y = 10,500 ----(I)

First sold at 20% profit

⇒ x + 20% of x = 120% of x

Other is sold at 10% loss

⇒ y – 10% of y = 90% of y

Selling price of both computers is same.

⇒ 120% of x = 90% of y

⇒ 120/100 × x = 90/100 × y

⇒ 4x = 3y

⇒ x = 3 and y = 4

Putting the above value in equation (I),

⇒ 3unit + 4unit = 10,500

⇒ 7unit = 10,500

⇒ 1unit = 10,500/7

⇒ 1unit = 1,500

SP of first computer,

⇒ 120% of x =120/100 × 3 × 1,500

⇒ 120 × 3 × 15 = 5,400

SP of second computer,

⇒ 90% of y = 90/100 × 4 × 1,500

⇒ 90 × 4 × 15 = 5,400

Total SP of both computers,

⇒ 5,400 + 5,400 =10,800

New gain,10,800 – 10,500 = 300

**∴ The net gain is Rs. 300**
